title: Payment Plan Installments on Home Delivery Pharmacy Accounts
content:
## Desk reference: installments of a payment plan

**Rule.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy account, when installments of the payment plan in force on the account (the account records a plan length) have fallen due unpaid, the member catches the plan up with an installment payment.

Installments of a payment plan fall due monthly, the first one month after the plan's request date, so the number fallen due is the number of whole months from the plan's request date to the handling date; an installment unpaid on its due date is overdue, and the plan ends only when an installment stays unpaid 60 calendar days after its due date.

**Effect.** The payment posts as a plan installment payment carrying the number of the last installment it brings the plan through, and lowers the balance due by its amount.

### Capability

`pay_plan_installment_04171a93` lets a member pay installments of their own payment plan on their Northbridge Rx Home Delivery account. One call charges the stated amount to the payment instrument named, records it as a plan installment payment dated today carrying the installment number it brings the plan through, and lowers the balance due by that amount.

### How it is invoked

The member's own tool, which the customer themselves runs: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool`, giving the name `pay_plan_installment_04171a93`, and so hands it over; the member runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `mail_account_id` | the reference number of the member's home delivery account, as read to the member by the representative from the home delivery account lookup | identifier |
| `amount` | the amount the member pays now, exactly as the representative quoted it | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places |
| `installment_number` | the number of the last plan installment this payment covers, exactly as the representative quoted it | integer of at least 1 (installment sequence; 0 is never used here) |
| `payment_method` | the instrument the member pays with | one of `credit_card`, `debit_card`, `hsa_fsa_card` (health savings or flexible spending account card), `check` (paper check mailed); `not_applicable` is reserved for credits and is never correct for a payment |

### Return

A successful call returns `payment_id` (the payment confirmation number), `amount` (the amount paid, USD with 2 decimal places), `installment_number` (the plan installment the payment brings the plan through), `payment_method` (the instrument charged), `balance_due` (the balance left, USD with 2 decimal places) and `status` "posted", meaning the installment payment has been applied.

### Due dates, illustrated (hypothetical plan)

A plan requested on 15 January has its first installment fall due on 15 February, its second on 15 March, and so on. On 20 April three whole months have passed since the request date, so three installments have fallen due.
